message: 知らぬ者は痴れた者

name: Lolotte
message: 「Ignorance is a manifestation of sin」

name: Synn
message: 「What's gotten into you all of a sudden」

name: Lolotte
message: 「KiraFes is right around the corner, and yet there are people who don't even know about it!」

name: Sally
message: 「Yep, don't know. Peace!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Don't act so proud about it, Ms. Extra. You are a sinner」

name: Sally
message: 「I am?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Yes. And absolving you of that sin is our duty as the Student Council」

name: Sally
message: 「Huuuh~. I don't really get it」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Which is it?!」

name: Synn
message: 「In short, you want to get more people to know about KiraFes, right」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Yes, yes! That's it!」

name: Sally
message: 「What's KiraFes? Is it tasty?」

name: Synn
message: 「It's a sparkly, super-special, gorgeous festival held at Ryuusei Academy」

name: Sally
message: 「I-It's that amazing~~!?」

name: Synn
message: 「Plus, tons of stalls with delicious food are going to be there」

name: Sally
message: 「Really!? I wanna eat!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Since you are quite literally the Student Council's extra, Ms. Extra, your participation is mandatory」

name: Sally
message: 「No way, lucky me!」

name: Synn
message: 「Hahaha, in that case, would you mind helping us out?」

name: Sally
message: 「Yeah, yeah, I will, I will! I totally will, super will! I'll help like crazy!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「That's a wonderful attitude. Now then, let's do our best together!」

name: Sally
message: 「I'm not gonna lose to you, Loro-chi!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「It won't even be a contest」

name: Sally
message: 「Seriously, Lolo-chi, are you really that weak?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「It's the exact opposite, the opposite!」

name: Synn
message: 「Well then, how about we start by making some flyers, and try handing them out or putting them up?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Nice idea, President!」

name: Sally
message: 「Chirashi sushi!?」

name: Synn
message: 「Sounds delicious~」

name: Lolotte
message: 「A flier, F-L-I-E-R!!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Besides flyers, I'd also like to make things like signboards.」

name: Synn
message: 「Ooh, that's a brilliant idea.」

name: Sally
message: 「Hardtack!?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Then let's get started right away.」

name: Sally
message: 「Don't ignore me!!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「People won't know what it is unless we clearly show the text 'Kirafes'!!」

name: Sally
message: 「I'm telling you, we have to make the drawing bigger so it stands out more!」
On the surface it looks like their usual lovers' quarrel, yet both of them are bringing up solid points that are hard to dismiss.

name: Synn
message: 「Alright then, let's do this. If we combine both of your ideas--」

name: Lolotte
message: 「If I cannot have the best, then I choose nothing!」

name: Sally
message: 「Whose side are you on anyway, Prez!!」

name: Synn
message: 「Ugh... Whose side, well, that's... uh, hmmm~」

name: Synn
message: 「T-The side of justice... maybe?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「If we use this color, wouldn't it look nice and flashy?」

name: Sally
message: 「If we make the letters big and small, it'll look way more fun~」
Well, since they seem to be getting along, I'll go ahead and make a signboard to stick the flyers on.

name: Synn
message: 「Hammer the nails, tap-tap♪ Hit the mark, tap-tap♪」

name: Sally
message: 「Prez, what're you doing?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Isn't it obvious just by looking? I am practicing my singing.」

name: Sally
message: 「Not fair! Playing around all by yourself!」

name: Synn
message: 「Look closer! I'm making a sign!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Kyaa!! Please don't point that hammer this way!」

name: Sally
message: 「Pork cutlet!?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「No, no, Tontoro! We simply don't get along well with hammers...」

name: Synn
message: 「Well, they're often used to smash piggy banks, after all.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Please don't say it so bluntly! If you do that, I'll panic\s01」

name: Sally
message: 「Aw, come on. Even I wouldn't do something that wicked and cruel!!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Hyaa!!」

name: Synn
message: 「Whoa, watch out!」

name: Sally
message: 「You're such a scaredy-cat, Lolo-chi. Keep that up and you'll drop your pork cutlet again.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I told you, it's Tontoro!!」

name: Sally
message: 「So Prez, what are you doing with that hammer?」

name: Synn
message: 「Like this.」

name: Synn
message: 「Tap, tap, tap.」

name: Sally
message: 「Pig, pig, pig.」

name: Synn
message: 「See? The nail goes into the sign and holds it in place.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Oooh~~」

name: Sally
message: 「That looks kinda fun! Let me try too~~」

name: Synn
message: 「Are you sure you'll be okay?」

name: Sally
message: 「Easy-peasy, lemon squeezy\s07」

name: Synn
message: 「Are you still scared, Lolotte?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I-I'm not scared! I'm just watching to see how things go.」

name: Sally
message: 「It's fine. There won't be anything for you to do anyway.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Hearing that from the tag-along is a huge shock.」

name: Sally
message: 「Alright, I'll give it a try!」

name: Synn
message: 「First, hold the nail steady with your fingers like this. Then strike this flat part with the hammer.」

name: Sally
message: 「Whaaat, that's super easy. Okay, leave it to me!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Thump-thump...」

name: Synn
message: 「And make sure you aim properly, or else--」

name: Sally
message: 「Aaaalright! Cleave it in twooooo!」

name: Synn
message: 「Ah, what did I tell you.」
Sally is writhing in silent agony.

name: Synn
message: 「If you just swing with brute force, you'll hit the fingers holding it like that, so you have to be careful.」

name: Sally
message: 「Uu... roger...」

name: Synn
message: 「Bring it down slowly and straight from directly above. That way, the center won't waver.」

name: Sally
message: 「Slowly from directly above...」

name: Synn
message: 「Relax, relax. Your arm is shaking.」

name: Sally
message: 「Now!!」

name: Sally
message: 「Agaga...」
The impact is subtle, yet packs plenty of power. Letting out a loud scream might actually help ease the pain.

name: Synn
message: 「That one barely grazed it--so close. Though being close actually makes it easier to hit your fingers.」

name: Sally
message: 「Wh-what should I do...」

name: Synn
message: 「Keep your eyes firmly on the target. Right there.」

name: Sally
message: 「N-not done yet... This time for sure, carefully... I'm gonna aim right at the mark...」

name: Sally
message: 「Hyaaah!!」

name: Sally
message: 「Owww~~! Owww~~!」
She rolls around on the spot, writhing in pain.
In the end, the nail didn't even manage to pierce the board.
After witnessing this disaster, surely even Lolotte won't want to try it.

name: Lolotte
message: 「I'm so excited」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「P-President! Could you hold onto Tontoro for just a little while!?」

name: Synn
message: 「Urgh, this might be heavier than a human life...!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Hammer, check. Tontoro, check.」

name: Synn
message: 「I told Sally-chan this too, but if your hand shakes, you'll hit your fingers, so be careful, okay?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「To literally drive the nail home like that... You're quite skilled, President.」

name: Synn
message: 「I didn't really mean to make a pun, though\s02」

name: Lolotte
message: 「This is my first time using a hammer.」

name: Synn
message: 「You've never used one on Tontoro?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「That would be completely unthinkable~~!」
Even without using one, it seems like it breaks pretty regularly anyway.

name: Synn
message: 「Anyway, just relax. If you do it calmly, there's nothing to be afraid of.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I'll do my best not to end up miserable and pathetic like Omake-san.」

name: Sally
message: 「Huff, huff\s06」
Her finger is all swollen, leaving her no room to fight back.

name: Lolotte
message: 「Here I go. Haaah--」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Gah... ugh, a dull throb...」
Lolotte crouches down on the spot.

name: Lolotte
message: 「If you think something like this will break my spirit, you're dead wrong, Mr. Hammer...」

name: Synn
message: 「Aah, I told you not to tense up--」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Haau...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「No, no, this is nothing. I will step over Miss Extra's corpse and press on!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Hyuu...」
She's repeating Sally-chan's exact mistake. At this rate, we won't get anywhere.

name: Synn
message: 「Hmm... What should I do?」
Doing it myself would be faster, sure, but she's actually motivated. I want to respect that enthusiasm.
After all, that curiosity and adventurous spirit are Lolotte's best qualities.

name: Synn
message: 「I've got it!」

name: Synn
message: 「If we use pliers to hold the nail in place...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Ooh! Then my fingers won't be in danger anymore.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Whoa! I did it~~!」
It's super crooked, though the tip isn't poking out, so it's probably fine.

name: Lolotte
message: 「At this rate, I can do plenty more. Thank you very much, Mr. President\s04」

name: Synn
message: 「Once you get the hang of it, let's try making sure they go in straight. It'll look cleaner too.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Straight, right? Gotcha~~」
She gets right into the groove, hammering away. Just as you'd expect from someone with neat handwriting, she's good with her hands. Once she gets used to it, she drives them in cleaner and cleaner.

name: Sally
message: 「No fair~~! I wanna do it too~~!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Miss Extra can just sit back and suck her thumb while watching.」

name: Sally
message: 「I've already been sucking on it so long it's all pruned up--!\s09」

name: Synn
message: 「Hey, hey! Take turns, take turns.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「The signboard is finished, and the flyers are all printed too.」

name: Sally
message: 「Good work--! Alright, snack time!\s07」

name: Synn
message: 「We're not done yet. We still have to go around and hand out the flyers to everyone.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Yes!」

name: Sally
message: 「Lolo-chi! Let's have a contest to see who can hand out more!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「You really love turning everything into a competition, don't you? You're just like the Vice President.」

name: Sally
message: 「Ehhh~~. Then I'm not doing it」
And so, the three of us decided to hand them out together.

name: Lolotte
message: 「Please come and enjoy the Meteor Sparkle Festival~」

name: Eddie
message: 「'Sup」

name: Sally
message: 「Yorosukou!」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Yangtze River?」

name: Sally
message: 「It's Sparkle Fest! It's a super yummy, deliciously delicious festival!!」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Really~? That sounds like fun~」

name: Sally
message: 「It's fun and delicious!!」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Ahaha~. This kid is hilarious~」

name: Synn
message: 「You're no slouch yourself, Sacchin」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Please be sure to come as well, Miss Shrine Maiden」

name: Shio
message: 「Ooh, so this is the notice for the festival I have heard rumors of」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Yes!」

name: Shio
message: 「Drawn in by the lively music of the festival, mononoke may appear. Should that occur, leave it all to me」

name: Lolotte
message: 「It'll be fine. After all, we even have a Demon helping us out」

name: Shio
message: 「What madness is this!?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Look, please take a look over there」

name: Sally
message: 「I'll give one to Principal too!」

name: Helena
message: 「Oh my, thank you」

name: Sally
message: 「I'm the one who wrote these letters!!」

name: Helena
message: 「Is that so? You did quite a good job with them」

name: Sally
message: 「Ehehe~! Pretty amazing, right~~!!」

name: Helena
message: 「Next time, you should pay closer attention to the size of the letters. If you do that, it'll look even more amazing」

name: Sally
message: 「Yeah, I'll do my best--」
The fact that it says KiraF'e's is just part of the charm.

name: Lolotte
message: 「How is it? There's nothing to worry about like this, right♪」

name: Shio
message: 「Prepare to face judgment!!」

name: Synn
message: 「Shio-chan, calm down!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Oh my!? Azel-san, you showed up at just the right time」

name: Azel
message: 「I didn't」

name: Lolotte
message: 「For you too, Azel-san…… Here, a present!」
Saying so, Lolotte handed over a KiraFes flyer.

name: Azel
message: 「Unnecessary」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Now don't say that」

name: Azel
message: 「I have no need for it」

name: Lolotte
message: 「You don't need to hold back～～」

name: Azel
message: 「I am not holding back」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Now, now, push it right in」

name: Azel
message: 「Push……?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Shove it right in!!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「With this festival, even you are sure to have a fun time, Azel-san」

name: Lolotte
message: 「It's a sparkling school life, you know!」

name: Sally
message: 「Come on, we're moving on to the next one. We'll leave you behind」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Aah, please wa～～it!」

name: Synn
message: 「See ya, Azel. Excuse us, Helena-san」

name: Helena
message: 「Oh my, you got quite a lot. One, two, three…… thirty sheets?」

name: Azel
message: 「Utterly unnecessary」
